description.value: Bayside Lounge is a retro cocktail lounge on the second floor above the corner of Denman and Davie Streets in Vancouver's West End, offering sweeping panoramic views of English Bay. Established in the 1970s and anchored by its iconic sunken circular bar, it serves West Coast-inspired small plates, handcrafted cocktails, and weekend brunch alongside nightly DJ sets. Cyclists riding the nearby Seawall will find it a scenic and lively stop steps from the beach.
